verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI (probe-5) and a `stripe sandbox create` command that provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no registration (docs-45), which suits non-interactive and CI use. The crypto docs also describe programmatic flows: Bridge orchestration APIs (docs-40), a Bridge sandbox for testing without real money (docs-42), and machine payments that let agents pay programmatically (docs-37). However, none of this evidence shows CI or headless workflows for the crypto/stablecoin features themselves. Missing for 10: CI- or headless-specific documentation, crypto-specific CLI commands or test fixtures, and any hands-on reports of running stablecoin flows in CI.
